description: Read two config files from disk by path and diff them by MEANING (format inferred from the file extension unless overridden). Use this to check whether an edit changed anything real, compare a before/after, or verify a format migration. Set redact=true to keep secrets out of context.

arrayKey.description: Match arrays of objects by a field's value instead of by position, so reordering a list (e.g. a k8s env:/containers: block) is not reported. Bare field name ('name') or scoped 'pathGlob=field'.

arraySet.description: Compare arrays as unordered multisets instead of by index.

formatA.description: Force the format of the first input (else inferred from filename/content).

formatB.description: Force the format of the second input.

ignore.description: Path globs to ignore, dot notation (e.g. 'metadata.creationTimestamp', 'spec.**').

loose.description: Loose scalar comparison: coerce string<->number<->boolean so "3" == 3.

only.description: If set, ONLY paths matching these globs are compared.

pathA.description: Path to the first config file.

pathB.description: Path to the second config file.

redact.description: Mask secret VALUES (passwords/tokens/keys, detected by key name) as a stable non-reversible fingerprint, so plaintext secrets never enter your context while drift is still visible.

redactEntropy.description: With redact: also mask values that LOOK like secrets (long, high-entropy) under any key.

name: diff_config_files
title: Diff two config files on disk semantically
